stem: Writing accessories such as letter openers, pen trays, and memorandum pads became tremendously popular during the Victorian era, and by far the most ubiquitous of such ____ was the letter box.
It is possible to (i)____ the benefits of diplomatic dialogue, because although it can certainly alleviate some of the problems that afflicts us, it is not a (ii)____.
Seemingly to compensate for the (i)____ nature of her subject, in her review the theater critic (ii)____ a casual chatty style.

Because leadership in the computer hacker group is extremely (i)____, when law enforcement agencies arrested several prominent members, taking them offline, the group (ii)____. Instead, it continues to operate, sometimes under its own name, sometimes under other names. The names are (iii)____, as are the members of the group: anyone, anywhere, is free to work behind its mask.

It is readily apparent that structures and functions of immature forms in organism as diverse as butterflies and frogs are not necessarily mere ____ of adult traits but represent specific adaptations to life in the niches occupied by juveniles.

____ neuroscience’s explanatory power, Patricia Churchland maintains that questions that have been discussed to no effect by philosophers over many centuries are solvable once rephrased as questions of neuroscience.
The firm’s startling admission of bookkeeping irregularities called into question the ____ of the oversight that government exercises over the financial health of private business.
